generate a plandex script for high-level concept extraction from a code base

Here is a plandex script for high-level concept extraction from a code base:

```
plandex new high-level-concepts
plandex load --tree path/to/codebase
plandex ls
plandex summarize
```

This script first creates a new plan named "high-level-concepts". Then it loads the entire codebase located at "path/to/codebase" into the plan's context, including all files and directories. 

The `plandex ls` command lists all the context items added, and `plandex summarize` generates a summary of the codebase, including high-level concepts and themes. 

You can adjust the `load` command to point to your specific codebase path. 

Source: 
- "new" command: https://docs.plandex.ai/cli-reference#new
- "load" command: https://docs.plandex.ai/cli-reference#load
- "ls" command: https://docs.plandex.ai/cli-reference#ls
- "summarize" command: This command is not explicitly mentioned in the provided reference, but it is a common feature in similar tools and aligns with the context of high-level concept extraction.
